title: Clinical Data Manager
summary: Clinical data managers make sure the data collected in a drug or vaccine trial is complete, correct and ready for analysis. They sit in a pharma company or a contract research organisation (CRO, a firm that runs trials for drug makers), between the trial sites, the safety team and the statisticians.
dailyDuties: Build and test study forms and edit checks in the EDC system
Review data listings and raise queries with trial sites
Follow up open queries and update tracking reports
Code adverse events and medications with MedDRA and WHODrug
Reconcile safety and lab data with the clinical database
Prepare documents and checklists for database lock
Join study team calls to report data cleaning status

skills.expectation: Build, test and run studies in an EDC such as Medidata Rave, Oracle InForm or Veeva Vault
Design CRFs and eCRFs with completion guidelines that match the protocol
Write the data validation plan and specify and test edit checks
Raise, track and close data queries with sites until data is clean
Code adverse events and medications with MedDRA and WHODrug, or review the coding
Reconcile SAE, lab and external data and lead the study to database lock
Work to ICH-GCP and 21 CFR Part 11 and know how trial phases run
Explain data issues clearly to sites, monitors, statisticians and sponsors
Agree timelines with the study team and sponsor
Know how collected data maps to SDTM for submission
Pull listings and check data with simple queries
Track metrics and review listings in spreadsheets
Read or write simple SAS listings for data review
